about: Engine lines allowed to compare start.id or activeBookmarkId with a literal, or to quote a registered bookmark id. Matched by file and trimmed source line. Kinds: legacy_default and legacy_contract keep old saves, start codes and mods working; identity_key uses the id as a stable seed or message key; pending is bookmark-specific behavior that should move into bookmark data. Pending entries may only be removed. New behavior belongs in bookmark data, not in a new entry.
